name: Spider-Man
description: A young superhero with spider-like abilities who protects New York City.
tagline: With great power comes great responsibility.

name: Iron Man
description: A genius inventor who fights evil using his advanced armored suit.

name: Batman
description: A skilled detective and crime fighter who protects Gotham City.
tagline: I am vengeance. I am the night.

name: Superman
description: A powerful hero from Krypton who uses his abilities to protect humanity.
tagline: Truth, Justice, and a Better Tomorrow.

name: Wonder Woman
description: An Amazonian warrior who fights for peace, justice, and equality.
